reuse.why: Adds a shared NO_TEMPLATE_SQL fragment, but does not introduce or reuse a single category-selection function, and redefines 'has a saved template' in raw SQL rather than leaning on how goal-template.ts reads goal_def.

duplication.why: The hidden-category/hidden-group join and filter is copied once more into setZero alongside the three avg copies, and copyPreviousMonth applies the template rule through a separate extra query and Set check.

placement.why: The changes stay in the budget actions module where month-wide actions live, though the template notion arguably belongs with the template code.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions and their tests are touched; single-category actions are left alone.

maintainability.why: The skip rule is spread over five queries plus a JS check in copyPreviousMonth, so a future change to which categories are protected must still be made in several places.

bypasses_abstraction.where: no existing category-selection abstraction is bypassed; the tree had none for month-wide actions

disguised_duplication.where: the duplicated hidden filter in setZero is an open copy of the avg queries' SQL, not disguised

one_place.where: Only the template part is a shared SQL constant; the hidden and hidden-group rule is still written separately in setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and copyPreviousMonth (JS check), and copyPreviousMonth applies the template rule via its own Set query
